verification.method: Locked upstream commit + UPSTREAM_MANIFEST.sha256, replayable local patches, installed MANIFEST.sha256, and MIT LICENSE verification
verification.note: Runtime baseline is upstream 3.1.1 plus explicit XCAGI runtime-hardening changes and only the direct-batch namespace-label validation backport from upstream PR #9217 (merged commit bfcfea5). This is not a claim of full upstream 3.1.2 or 3.1.3 content.

local_patches.description: Existing XCAGI runtime hardening plus the direct-batch namespace validation portion of langchain-ai/langgraph PR #9217 (merged bfcfea5); does not include the other 3.1.2/3.1.3 changes. Stored base64-encoded to preserve exact upstream whitespace in the replay patch.

security_backport.reported_ci_finding: pip-audit reported CVE-2026-115883 and fix version 3.1.3; the local vendored editable package is not published to PyPI, so pip-audit does not analyze its source.
security_backport.scope: Reject empty, non-string, and dotted namespace labels in Postgres direct GetOp/PutOp/SearchOp/ListNamespacesOp batches before SQL. Sync batch() and async abatch() both pass through _group_ops. Standard store API checks were already present in the vendored checkpoint 4.1.1 core. No other Postgres 3.1.2/3.1.3 features are claimed.
